Container.Name: Ashan-FRP-Control-Center
Container.Overview: Ashan FRP Control Center is a Rust ChmlFrp global tunnel control plane for Unraid. Start the container first, then configure and test ChmlFrp and Cloudflare directly in the WebUI; provider secrets are persisted under /data and take effect without a Docker restart. All managed tunnels always share one global active ChmlFrp node. FRPC runs the complete configuration generated by ChmlFrp and its logs are used as the primary runtime fault signal. A confirmed remote node/server fault triggers one GLOBAL_FAILOVER for every managed tunnel, and managed Cloudflare A records are switched only after the new ChmlFrp/FRPC runtime is verified.
Container.Requires: No API token is required to create or start the container. After startup, open the WebUI Settings page to configure/test ChmlFrp and Cloudflare. Persistent application data and WebUI-managed provider secrets are stored on the cache pool at /mnt/cache/appdata/ashan-frp-control-center. Place the Linux amd64 ChmlFrp frpc binary at /mnt/cache/appdata/ashan-frp-control-center/frpc/frpc and make it executable before starting FRPC. The WebUI has no built-in user authentication and is intended for a trusted LAN/VPN; do not expose it directly to the public Internet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Ashan FRP Control Center WebUI host port. Container port is fixed at 8080.

Config.Name: AppData (Cache)
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, FRPC binary/configuration, logs and runtime state. Keep this path on /mnt/cache, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: ChmlFrp API Token
Config.Description: Optional first-start compatibility seed only. Recommended: leave empty and configure/test the ChmlFrp token in WebUI → Settings after the container starts.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: Optional first-start compatibility seed only. Recommended: leave empty and configure/verify the scoped Cloudflare token in WebUI → Settings.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone ID
Config.Description: Optional first-start compatibility seed only. WebUI → Settings can list accessible Cloudflare zones and fill the Zone ID automatically.

Config.Name: Initial Active ChmlFrp Node
Config.Description: Optional first-start routing seed. The preferred setup is WebUI → Settings. Once an Active node exists, later changes must use GLOBAL_FAILOVER.

Config.Name: Initial Standby ChmlFrp Node
Config.Description: Optional first-start preferred standby seed. All tunnels always share the same global Active node.

Config.Name: Failed Node Quarantine Days
Config.Description: Optional first-start routing seed. Default 30 days; later changes are managed in WebUI → Settings.

Config.Name: Automatic Global Failover
Config.Description: Optional first-start routing seed. Default true; later changes are managed in WebUI → Settings.

Config.Name: ChmlFrp API Base URL
Config.Description: Optional first-start compatibility seed. Normally leave unchanged; WebUI → Settings can update it at runtime.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Base URL
Config.Description: Optional first-start compatibility seed. Normally leave unchanged; WebUI → Settings can update it at runtime.

Config.Name: FRPC Log Tail
Config.Description: Maximum number of recent FRPC log lines retained for runtime inspection.

Config.Name: Rust Log Level
Config.Description: Rust tracing filter for server/container logs.
